paragraphs.text: The Gitte-Yatay mountains are located east of Madara 's main lands. The mountains are a powerful source of red mana. The spring of the Suido River is located in this mountain range.
The headquarters of the Kentsu were located in this mountain range.

During the Madara-Edemi War , Tetsuo Umezawa cast the Meteor Hammer spell on the Imperial Shrine , destroying it. This also blasted a hole through the Gitte-Yatay Mountains, separating them into a northern and southern chain.
